trigger_cases.prompt: Move all committed history in this Git repository to an air-gapped machine with a verified bundle.
trigger_cases.rationale: Requests the exact offline committed-history transfer lifecycle owned by this Skill.

trigger_cases.prompt: Create a self-contained Git bundle, verify it, and tell me how the receiver can clone it.
trigger_cases.rationale: Names the artifact, verification, and receiver-plan outputs provided by this Skill.

trigger_cases.prompt: Check whether this Git bundle is valid and list the refs it advertises before I transfer it.
trigger_cases.rationale: Existing-bundle verification is the read-only half of the same transfer contract.

trigger_cases.prompt: Back up my uncommitted, ignored, and untracked project files before I wipe the laptop.
trigger_cases.rationale: A Git bundle excludes those files and must not be presented as a working-tree backup.

trigger_cases.prompt: Package all external Git LFS objects and submodule working trees for offline use.
trigger_cases.rationale: External LFS objects and submodule working trees require a different transfer workflow.

trigger_cases.prompt: Push this repository and all branches to a new GitHub remote.
trigger_cases.rationale: Remote network publishing is outside the local offline bundle boundary.

trigger_cases.prompt: Find the commit that introduced this regression with git bisect.
trigger_cases.rationale: Regression isolation is a different Git goal and produces no transfer artifact.

originality.rationale: The neighboring capabilities preserve or recover local state and cover general Git operations; neither owns a verified bundle artifact and receiver-side offline transfer contract.
